01 / Who I am

Background

I'm a Computer Science undergraduate working toward a career in software engineering. I enjoy understanding how systems work, breaking down problems and turning ideas into practical applications that people can use.

My interests lie in backend development and AI-powered applications. Through projects such as Expense Tracker API, AI Study Assistant and AfterBell, I work with Java, Spring Boot, Python and FastAPI to build APIs, manage data and connect application features. I also explore retrieval-augmented generation to help users interact with their own documents.

Alongside building projects, I’m strengthening my foundations in data structures, object-oriented programming, databases and software testing. My goal is to grow into a thoughtful software engineer who can understand a problem, make sound technical decisions and build solutions that are clear, reliable and useful.
